carousel_story_director_persona.source_story: Long distance makes you miss boring things, not only dates or trips. If there was no long distance, the two of them would be texting tiny future plans: cooking together even though it is a terrible idea, board game night with invented rules after losing, and being secretly happy the cab is late because it buys a few more minutes. The emotional truth: maybe they do not miss big dates; maybe they just miss wasting normal time together.
